hypothesis: Source per-class BCE mixes proposal objectness with class preference. Conditional supported-positive versus supported-zero ranking learns material class directions while a frozen complete availability-quality network supplies the strong proposal-quality anchor.

architecture.residual_output: 2*tanh, final weight and bias zero initialized
architecture.training_center_precision: Differentiable CUDA Float64 sum and mean of canonical Float32 raw_delta, Float64 difference/2, finally Float32

training.data: Grouped already-aligned source train/val classes; source-only labels; all class catalogues kept, CID0 valid, padding-1. SourceCLC and CLC_tune auxiliary material bank from sealed third-round alignment; six target test manifests unchanged.
training.constant_guards: Residual constants fitted from all original valid source-train class tuples before permutation. Context constants fitted from original source-train proposals. No empirical scaling. Apply raw whole-material permutation before guards; shared guards for both roles.
training.pair_loss: For supported P={c:y_c>0},N={c:y_c=0}, sum_p y_p sum_n softplus(-(z_p-z_n))/(sum_p y_p*|N|). Only proposals with T>=2 and nonempty P,N. Multiple positives never negative to each other.
training.conditional_population: Equal source, eligible image, eligible proposal; 979 draws with replacement per source, 2937 total/epoch
training.regularizer_population: Independent equal source, all image, all proposal draws; includes background and unsupported-positive proposals; 979/source,2937/epoch
training.regularizer: 0.01 times mean over full-population drawn proposals of mean_supported(centered_delta^2); empty support contributes0
training.sampler: CPU torch.Generator conditional seed=s; independent regularizer seed=s+1000003; weighted multinomial within source then2937 draw permutation; same generators/draws/initialization/12 paired updates across roles
training.optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.0001; batch256 per population,12 paired updates; max100epochs, patience15,min_delta1e-6
training.best_checkpoint: Initial epoch-1 zero-new-branch candidate included. Early stopping and checkpoint selection use pure full source-val weighted conditional pairwise loss ONLY, no regularizer. Full source/image/eligible-proposal weighting; fixed label-free validation permutation. No CT/test selection.

permutation_control.target: Only whole raw X8..11 four-tuples within actual supported canonical classes; G0..7, supportX12, catalogue labels, padding and original shared bag context unchanged
permutation_control.algorithm: For each proposal SHA256 compactJSON ['conditional_material_permutation_v1',seed,phase,epoch_or_null,*proposal_key]; first16digestbytes little-endian seed for numpy PCG64; uniform permutation without replacement, fixed points allowed
permutation_control.training_key: phase='train',epoch and(source_index,image_index,global_cache_index); repeated proposal in same epoch same permutation
permutation_control.effective_capacity_claim: Same architecture, parameter counts, sampler and optimization budget. The material permutation destroys class alignment and is not asserted to give identical effective expressive capacity or a causal counterfactual.
